patterns.text: 28 of 42 alerts (66.7%) fire in the 2-4am window, indicating off-hours noise dominates triage load
28 recurring alerts (66.7%) vs 14 one-off alerts shows fatigue is driven by repeats, not novel incidents
Top owner alex holds 31 of 42 alerts (73.8%) vs priya 5, jordan 3, sam 3, indicating single-owner bottleneck
All 7 components tied at 6 alerts each (checkout, inventory, kds, loyalty, menu-sync, payments, receipts) suggests systemic threshold or batch cause rather than single-service failure
3 silenced of 42 total with 1.4 alerts per day over 30 days indicates low suppression and steady daily drain

refined_purpose.statement: Propose triage to cut 2-4am recurring noise and rebalance ownership from alex to protect daytime checkout and payments reliability.
refined_purpose.rationale: Because 66.7% recurring and 66.7% 2-4am concentration with 73.8% owned by alex drives fatigue without improving coverage of 14 one-off P1/P2s

alerts.chat:
Biggest problem is 28 of 42 alerts (66.7%) are recurring and 28 of 42 (66.7%) fire in the 2-4am window, with alex holding 31 of 42 alerts (73.8%) vs priya 5, jordan 3, sam 3.

Fix: debounce the 2-4am recurring alerts and rotate ownership from alex to priya, jordan and sam to cut off-hours noise and rebalance load, while protecting coverage of the 14 one-off alerts with 1.4 alerts per day over 30 days.

assess.narrative: I cover the 66.7% recurring, 66.7% 2-4am, and 73.8% alex concentration well, but my checkout/payments focus is unsupported when all 7 components tie at 6 each, my business-hours reliability and runbook signals are only moderate/weak proxies, my memory stores counts without tuning actions, and I have no scenarios to test rebalancing risk.

proposals.title: Make purpose measurable and component-neutral
proposals.change: Revise statement to target cut 2-4am recurring share from 66.7% and alex share from 73.8% while protecting daytime ack for 14 one-offs, removing unsupported checkout/payments-only focus unless justified by severity data

proposals.title: Add daytime reliability guardrail
proposals.change: Add leading signal for daytime checkout/payments P1/P2 ack or error rate to directly guard the protect-reliability clause that current one-off ack signal only weakly covers

proposals.title: Strengthen runbook tuning signal definition
proposals.change: Define alerts with runbook-linked quiet-hours tuning proposals with explicit numerator/denominator and increase target to make debounce/threshold tuning progress observable beyond weak proxy

proposals.title: Compact probe digest into actionable tuning memory
proposals.change: Summarize turn 1 patterns into retained facts: batch-cause hypothesis for tied components, low suppression at 3 silenced, and prior rebalance suggestion, to avoid re-deriving 28/42 and 31/42 each turn

proposals.title: Simulate alex-unavailable rebalance
proposals.change: Add scenario redistributing 31 alex alerts to priya/jordan/sam to test daytime coverage of 14 one-offs and 1.4 per day load if top owner is out

proposals.title: Simulate 2-4am quiet-hours debounce
proposals.change: Add scenario applying debounce/threshold tuning to 28 2-4am recurring alerts to project reduction in north-star volume and recurring share without harming business-hours ack
